crossRefs.note: His division, and those who were counted of them, were seventy-four thousand six hundred.
His division, and those who were counted of them, were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.
These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty-two thousand two hundred.
These are the families of Judah according to those who were counted of them, seventy-six thousand five hundred.

translations.web: Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brothers didn’t have many children, and all their family didn’t multiply like the children of Judah.
translations.bsb: Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters, but his brothers did not have many children, so their whole clan did not become as numerous as the sons of Judah.
translations.kjv: And Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brethren had not many children, neither did all their family multiply, like to the children of Judah.
translations.asv: And Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brethren had not many children, neither did all their family multiply like to the children of Judah.
